infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SHIELD requires location services while on duty to map tactical officer deployment.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Continuous background location is mandated during officer on-duty shifts for squad safety and incident dispatch.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SHIELD requires camera access for on-duty incident recording and digital evidence capture.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SHIELD requires microphone access for audio statement logging and emergency panic broadcasting.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Biometric authentication is required to unlock confidential case records.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SHIELD to access device location during active police duty.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SHIELD to record photos and video evidence.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow SHIELD to use FaceID/Fingerprint for officer verification.
